title: Answer your accountant's bank questions
summary: See the bank lines your accountant asked about and say what each one was.

steps.text: Open {nav} from the sidebar. Each card is a bank line your accountant asked about, with its date, bank, description and amount, and their question.

Write what the payment was under {what} and who it was paid to or from, add a {receipt} if you have one, then click {save}. Your accountant sees the answer at once, and it becomes the suggestion for that line on the bank page.
{open} lists the questions still waiting for you, {answered} the ones you have answered, and {all} every question. A question your accountant takes back no longer waits for you.
Anyone with the permission to answer bank questions sees this page, so a client can answer without seeing the rest of the books. Your accountant gives that permission in Settings under Users.
